verdict.rationale: three.js is an MIT-licensed, client-side JavaScript 3D rendering library installed via npm. It hosts and stores no user data, so choosing a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any hosted storage or region-selection capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
